The '''Pindra system''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located near the [[Colla system/Legends|Colla]] and [[Chazwa system/Legends|Chazwa systems]], the latter situated along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. Pindra was the site of trap laid by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Willham Burke]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] that led to the destruction of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Admiral [[Ledre Okins]], further opening the way for the New Republic to eventually [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|retake]] the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
